correctness.rationale: The difference set criterion proves injectivity of (a,b)↦a+b iff no nonzero codeword difference of A equals an opposite difference of B. Fix 0∈A by translating both codebooks by the same XOR mask, equivalently complementing selected coordinates in both (output coordinate flips z↦2−z). Independent newly written C++17 exhaustive algorithm enumerated all 32768 odd A masks, computed 16-vertex conflict graphs and exact MIS recurrence to verify max |A|alpha(G_A)=36. A separate cardinality-constrained full B enumeration found 966 rooted maximum pairs: 192 of (4,9),342 of (6,6),432 of (9,4); XOR translates deduplicated to 2448 ordered labeled pairs with size groups 768,912,768. Enumerating 24 coordinate permutations×16 simultaneous XORs×two user orders partitioned them into 11 orbits of sizes 48 (1),96 (3),192 (3),384 (4). This is exhaustive on the finite 4-bit universe; output was reproduced independently and agrees with actual code, not just logs.
